misconfig_patterns: Jupyter Lab on 8888 with c.NotebookApp.token='' (JetBot/JetRacer classroom default) — anyone on the network can open notebooks, run cells with GPU + camera + robot motor access
Jupyter Lab on 8888 with token in URL — the URL has been crawled by Shodan or shared in classroom Slack
DeepStream RTSP server on 8554 with no auth — streams AI-inferred video including bounding-box overlays revealing the operator's trained model classes

Isaac ROS DDS profile uses default FastRTPS profile without SROS2 — all topics (including /visual_slam/tracking/odometry, /tag_detections, /cmd_vel) are unauthenticated; ROS_DOMAIN_ID is the only segregation and defaults to 0
Jetson DevKit SSH (port 22) reachable from internet with factory-default nvidia/nvidia or jetbot/jetbot credentials still in place
Foxglove bridge (port 8765) running with no auth, exposes ROS2 topic catalog and live data over WebSocket — common because the bridge is the convenience access path for remote debugging
web_video_server on 8080 streams raw camera MJPEG with no auth
Nsight Eclipse remote-debug ports 8000-8010 forwarded to the public internet during dev (LAN-development-only tell when exposed)

Docker registry on Jetson builder host with /v2/_catalog leak — surfaces operator's full container portfolio including model containers, RAG indexes, and Isaac ROS variant tags (operator-attribution chain; existing aimap classifyJetsonRepos enumerator)
Ollama on 11434 co-deployed on the Jetson — LLM-jacking primitive on GPU-attached robot hardware
Triton inference server on 8001-8003 on the same Jetson, model repository readable, model files extractable
ROS_DOMAIN_ID still set to 0 on a fielded robot — joins any 0-domain DDS peer that reaches the network

active_probe.false_positive_check: Jupyter sessions JSON is a list of objects each carrying kernel.id, kernel.name, path, and type=='notebook'. Reject if /api/sessions returns 403/401 (token enforced) or if body is HTML — that is a reverse-proxy interception. For Jetson attribution, pair with GET /api/contents/ — a real Jetson notebook tree leaks paths like /home/jetbot/Notebooks/, /home/jetson/, /workspace/isaac_ros_*, or filenames including l4t / tegra / cuvslam. Generic Jupyter on x86 will not show those path tells. DeepStream RTSP probe: OPTIONS rtsp://<ip>:8554/* returns Server: GStreamer RTSP server — unique to GStreamer-based DeepStream (also fires on generic GStreamer RTSP samples; confirm via DESCRIBE response SDP including nvinfer or nv-yolov8 plugin tells).

shodan_dorks.notes: Per Insight #93, at least one variant runs without port:N constraint. http.html:"JetBot" and ssl.cert.subject.cn:"jetson" are the port-free variants. Jupyter dorks need body marker (jetson, L4T, JetBot) to avoid x86 Jupyter FP. DeepStream RTSP banner is GStreamer-unique but not Jetson-unique; pair with body containing 'deepstream' or strip-FP at Stage 0c via DESCRIBE SDP. Isaac ROS DDS topics are DDS-dark (UDP multicast) — NOT Shodan-indexable; counted in squad-2 ROS2 brief. Docker registry chain is the operator-attribution path and feeds aimap's existing classifyJetsonRepos (enumerators.go lines 1153-1190).

GET /api/kernels → running kernels with last-activity timestamps
GET /api/terminals → active terminal sessions (the killer find — shell access already open in browser)

OPTIONS rtsp://<ip>:8554/* → DeepStream RTSP method list + Server: GStreamer RTSP server
DESCRIBE rtsp://<ip>:8554/ds-test or /test → SDP reveals codec, resolution, plugin chain (nvinfer = model class leak)

Shadow-sweep on same /32: 22, 8888, 8554, 8765, 8080, 11434, 8001-8003 — single Jetson commonly runs the full stack

do_not_call: POST /api/kernels/<id>/execute — runs arbitrary code on Jetson with GPU + camera + motor access; this is RCE on physical hardware
POST /api/terminals — opens full shell, equivalent RCE
PUT /api/contents/<path> — writes attacker-controlled file to Jetson filesystem
POST /api/sessions — creates new kernel session, state-changing
Any DeepStream nvmsgbroker control POST — changes pipeline, modifies what the AI is doing
ros2 action send_goal /navigate_to_pose ... — MOVES THE ROBOT
ros2 service call /set_parameters ... on Isaac ROS nodes — reconfigures perception stack
SSH login with default nvidia/nvidia or jetbot/jetbot credentials — active credential use, out of scope for public-source survey
POST to Ollama /api/generate when co-deployed — LLM-jacking primitive on operator's GPU
data_class: AI-inferred video stream (DeepStream RTSP — exposes operator model class via bounding-box labels), real-time robot pose (Isaac ROS visual_slam topics — physical location of the robot in real-time), camera feed (web_video_server MJPEG — facility imagery), filesystem contents (Jupyter /api/contents — code, notebooks, .env files, model weights), and remote code execution surface (Jupyter execute, terminals, SSH default creds). When co-deployed with Ollama: compute resource (LLM-jacking on GPU)
restraint_notes: Open-state is the finding; calling is the harm. The Jupyter exec endpoint open-state is the report-worthy fact; do not POST /execute to demonstrate it.
Isaac ROS DDS topic open-state is the finding; subscribing read-only with ros2 topic echo from a LAN-co-resident host is in scope under engagement, but never publish to /cmd_vel or send action goals.

DeepStream RTSP open-state is the finding; OPTIONS and DESCRIBE are read-only and acceptable. PLAY/SETUP that opens a session can be interpreted as bandwidth-affecting on resource-constrained Jetson; minimize.
Docker registry /v2/_catalog leak chains to operator attribution (aimap classifyJetsonRepos) without ever needing to pull an image. Do not pull images.
SSH default-credential testing is out of scope for OSINT phase. Banner enumeration only.

Insight #40 (auth-on-default shifts rightward): NVIDIA Isaac ROS docs since 2024 push SROS2 examples and JetPack 6 hardens default Jupyter (no longer ships token-less out of box). The exposed population skews older JetPack 4/5 + classroom-kit images. Track release fraction.
Insight #93: at least one Shodan dork without port:N constraint. http.html:'JetBot' and ssl.cert.subject.cn:'jetson' satisfy this.
Insight #12 shadow-sweep priorities are baked into deployment_tells — single Jetson concentrates the full stack on one /32.

version_history_auth_relevant.JetPack 4 (L4T R32): Jetson Nano / TX2 era — Jupyter on JetBot ships token-less; SSH default nvidia/nvidia; no SROS2 in user-facing examples
version_history_auth_relevant.JetPack 5 (L4T R35) — 2022: Xavier / Orin era — Jupyter still ships token-less in classroom kits; Isaac ROS releases start including SROS2 example branches but not on by default
version_history_auth_relevant.JetPack 6 (L4T R36) — 2024: Orin era only — Jupyter classroom kits begin to ship with persistent random token written to /home/.../.jupyter/jupyter_notebook_config.py at first boot; SROS2 example workflows in Isaac ROS 3.x; default user prompt at first boot replaces hardcoded nvidia/nvidia (mirrors RPi 2022 trajectory)
version_history_auth_relevant.Isaac ROS 0.x (2022): package set debut; cuVSLAM as proprietary binary; all examples run without auth on default DDS profile
version_history_auth_relevant.Isaac ROS 2.x (2024): Foundation Pose, nvblox 3D reconstruction added; SROS2 examples in docs but documented as 'advanced'
version_history_auth_relevant.Isaac ROS 3.x (2025): Foxglove integration first-class; SROS2 examples promoted; default Jupyter token-on-by-default for new kit images
version_history_auth_relevant.Isaac Sim (cloud sim): paid SaaS with auth — OUT OF SCOPE

high_severity_combo: Jetson on public internet + Jupyter on 8888 open (token-less or token-in-URL) + Isaac ROS DDS unsegregated (ROS_DOMAIN_ID=0 default) + camera bound + motor controller bound = remote ML notebook with GPU + live camera + motor control. Each open-state alone qualifies: Jupyter open = RCE on robot; Isaac ROS DDS open = robot motion control over LAN; DeepStream RTSP open = operator-attribution + model-class leak via inferred-video bounding boxes.
